purpose: Reverse-trace domain_meta.json to the local domain-definition library and validate its recorded ISIC/ISCO anchors against the supplied source files without changing the current taxonomy.

revision_reconciliation.intended_workflow_revision: Rev.5 canonical; Rev.4 retained only for historical crosswalk
revision_reconciliation.finding: UNSD endorses ISIC Rev.5 as the current revision. The domain library mixes revision-sensitive section letters and code granularities, so its raw values require the official Rev.4-to-Rev.5 correspondence table. Code shape alone cannot identify the intended revision or silently replace the raw value.
revision_reconciliation.required_action: Freeze one canonical ISIC revision, preserve every raw library value, and map each value through an explicit authoritative crosswalk that records whether the issue is code granularity, revision, section reassignment, or a true missing anchor. Do not replace codes by prefix automatically.

source_roles_in_documented_flow.isic_rev5_canonical: industry_context_layer: ISIC Rev.5 is the canonical current industry-context revision; the official Rev.4-to-Rev.5 table reconciles historical or revision-sensitive library values. ISIC is not an occupation or skill taxonomy.
source_roles_in_documented_flow.isco08: occupational_function_layer: major/sub-major/unit-group anchors used to describe the kind of work and organize roles.
source_roles_in_documented_flow.esco_v121: role_and_skill_layer: normalized occupation labels, aliases, descriptions, skills and ISCO-linked occupation records.
source_roles_in_documented_flow.onet: task/work-context/entrepreneurial-signal layer in the supplied library; current repository keeps O*NET extracts/profiles as global proxy evidence.
source_roles_in_documented_flow.wef: trend-signal layer for growing/declining roles and skills; not a complete domain or role taxonomy.

traceability_conclusion.domain_identity_classification: complete_for_current_records: exact source terminology, source-supported umbrella, or curated addition
traceability_conclusion.interpretation: D001-D166 can be traced structurally to the supplied 166-domain definition library. ISIC Rev.5 is now the canonical industry-context revision and the official Rev.4-to-Rev.5 crosswalk is recorded separately; eight listed ISCO unit-group codes still require source review. The current domain_meta.json is an adapted projection: it preserves IDs, labels, clusters and flags but not the per-domain ISIC/ISCO/ESCO citations. The audit artifact preserves those references and the regenerated seed now ingests them into domain provenance. D167-D168 are later repository additions; their registry references are classified as routing metadata, and unregistered IDs are not treated as checked evidence. This proves lineage to the documented library and records the remaining source-review boundary without changing the taxonomy.
